thread:
rachel: Heads-up 1: final draft of the Product X launch post is ready for quick review. Need checks on messaging accuracy, benchmark wording, and the CTA link mapping. Goal: publish Wed 9am PT.

diego: On it. I can do headline + KPI language. Any constraints from product?

lisa: Product ask: keep the headline technical but approachable. Suggest: 'Scale LLM inference with predictable latency' instead of marketing-y phrasing.

omar: Love that. For the benchmark section, let's avoid absolutes. Proposed line: 'In our Dedicated environment, workloads maintained ~900 requests/sec and sustained token throughput, measured on standard evaluation prompts.'

kevin: Add a micro-callout for test context: "Test environment: 4xH100, seq=256, mixed batching." Important for reproducibility.

rachel: Good call. Keep that callout collapsed on mobile. Also, marketing ops: we need UTM + HubSpot hidden fields for CTA and the webinar registration so Sales gets routed.

ops-bot: Suggested UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=prod_x_launch_2026. Hidden HubSpot fields: campaign_id=prod_x_launch_2026, lead_origin=blog, product_interest=dedicated.

lisa: For the CTA copy, do we use "Try Product X" or "See Product X in action"? The latter ties into the webinar.

diego: Prefer "See Product X in action" for hero CTA and a separate "Get started" for bottom-of-post action.

omar: Legal note: don't compare numbers vs competitors or use 'the fastest'. Keep neutral. Also avoid 'zero downtime' style absolutes.

legal-bot: Legal quick-check: flagged phrase 'production-grade' ok, but replace 'guaranteed' if present. Include privacy notice by the webinar form: "We collect contact details per our Privacy Policy."

kevin: Visuals: I'll make a lightweight benchmark chart and a GIF of end-to-end request flow. Need final copy by EOD to generate assets.

rachel: I'll swap in product-approved headline and add the kevin callout with test env. For the benchmark sentence, edited to "sustained token throughput under mixed-batch workloads" per Omar's suggestion.

ops-bot: Reminder: make sure server-side lead tagging applies for direct CTA clicks (not only form submissions). Ops will add tag 'prod_x_launch_2026'.

lisa: Can we include a short placeholder customer quote + attribution slot? e.g., "Product X helped us cut inference variance and simplify deployment." We'll replace with real quote in final pass.

diego: Also, small SEO tweak: add 'dedicated inference' and 'LLM inference latency' to subhead and meta.

rachel: Done. Pushed draft to preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1717009999. Please review copy + mobile layout.

omar: Quick micro-edit: change 'requests/sec' to 'concurrent requests/sec' to be clearer.

kevin: Asset ETA: 2 hours after final copy.

legal-bot: When ready, tag @legal for a 20-minute final pass. I'll queue it.

rachel: Plan: finalize copy by 4:30pm PT, legal pass 4:40pm, ops to wire UTMs and server tags, schedule publish Wed 9am PT. Thanks all! :tada:
